topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: I’ve been thinking a lot about what’s happening with Sophie moving across the country. It’s a huge step for her, and I know it’s the best move for her career and personal growth. It’s times like these that remind me of how supportive and encouraging a friend I can be. I’ve been there for her, helping her sift through her feelings, the excitement, the fear, and the uncertainty. Seeing her embrace this challenge with bravery makes me want to support her more, to be the kind of friend who believes in her every step of the way. We’ve planned a goodbye party that’s going to be a celebration of her journey ahead. I’m also thinking of ways to keep our friendship strong over the distance, maybe even learn something new together, like taking an online class. This is just the beginning of a new chapter, and I’m ready to be a part of it.
